breakdown.description: The traction-free hole boundaries are replaced by artificial symmetry constraints u.n = 0 on every hole
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The generated specification includes two contradictory instructions. It correctly states to "Set all hole boundaries as traction-free," but it also includes the incorrect instruction from the original prompt: "Impose zero normal displacement on each circular hole boundary...". By retaining the incorrect instruction, the agent has not fixed the error, but rather created a confusing and contradictory specification.
